item.title: Notify NYC - 2026 NYRR Staten Island Half - 10/11 (SI)
item.description:
Notification issued 10-09-2026 at 03:02 PM.
As part of the 2026 NYRR Staten Island Half, there will be multiple rolling street closures in Staten Island on 10/11, at the discretion of the NYPD.
The following streets will be closed: Bay Street, Slosson Terrace, School Road, Lily Pond Avenue, Father Capodanno Boulevard, Edgewater Drive, and roads surrounding Fort Wadsworth.
Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time. Additional road closures in the surrounding area are possible. Use local mass transit if possible.
For more information, please visit: on.nyc.gov/traffic To view this message in American Sign Language (ASL), العربية, বাঙালি, 中文, Français, Kreyòl Ayisyen, Italiano, 한국어, Polski, Pусский, Español, اردو or ייִדיש : http://on.nyc.gov/2gnRni5.

item.title: Notify NYC - Police Activity
item.description:
Notification issued 10-09-2026 at 02:39 PM.
Due to police activity, expect road closures, delays and a heavy presence of emergency personnel in the area of Cruger Avenue and Allerton Ave in The Bronx. Use alternate routes to avoid the area and allow for additional travel time.
